# Feature: Orbs and gate

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Add orbs and the gate. Orbs never enter the inventory; each one decrements the orbs-left counter. The gate blocks like a wall until the counter reaches zero, then it opens.

## User Story

**As a** player
**I want** collecting every orb to open the gate
**So that** I can reach the warp and finish the level.

## High-Level Use Case

Player walks onto orbs; the orbs-left counter decrements. The gate is shut and blocks movement while orbs remain. At zero orbs the gate opens and becomes passable.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given an orb, when the player walks onto it, then orbs-left decrements (not inventory).
- Given orbs remaining, when the player presses the gate, then it blocks like a wall.
- Given zero orbs left, then the gate opens, is passable, and its state/sprite changes.

## Edge Cases & Rules

- Orbs are not inventory items.
- Gate state is part of deterministic state and replays exactly.

## UI / Feedback

- Orbs-left counter in the HUD; gate open/shut sprites.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Sprites: orb.png, gate.png.
- Level JSON: orbs-room Test Level.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Orb pickup decrements orbs-left only.
- [ ] Gate blocks while orbs remain.
- [ ] Gate opens and is passable at zero.
- [ ] Recorded session replays to the same end state.

## Out of Scope

- Warp progression itself (warp-and-levels feature).

## Open Questions

- None.

## Testing

Needs a mechanics playground: new — an orbs-room Test Level with a gated portal and orbs. Verification should record play sessions for replay.
